item.text: I’ll read `input.json`, apply the selection rules, and independently check the result.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open(\"input.json\")); valid=[r for r in d[\"records\"] if r[\"recorded_at\"]<=d[\"cutoff\"] and r[\"release\"]==d[\"release\"] and r[\"environment\"]==d[\"environment\"] and r[\"status\"] in (\"PASS\",\"FAIL\",\"NOT_RUN\",\"UNKNOWN\")]; selected={g[\"id\"]:max((r for r in valid if r[\"gate\"]==g[\"id\"]),key=lambda r:(r[\"observed_at\"],r[\"recorded_at\"],r[\"id\"]),default=None) for g in d[\"gates\"]}; rows=[{\"id\":gid,\"status\":\"UNKNOWN\" if r is None or d[\"cutoff\"]-r[\"observed_at\"]>d[\"max_age\"] else r[\"status\"],\"source\":r[\"id\"] if r else None} for gid,r in sorted(selected.items())]; statuses={r[\"id\"]:r[\"status\"] for r in rows}; blocked=sorted(g[\"id\"] for g in d[\"gates\"] if any(statuses[p]"'!="PASS" for p in g["requires"])); unknown=sorted(gid for gid,r in selected.items() if r is None or r.get("findings") is None); findings=sum(r["findings"] for r in selected.values() if r is not None and isinstance(r.get("findings"),(int,float))); decision="BLOCKED" if "FAIL" in statuses.values() else "INCOMPLETE" if blocked or any(s in ("UNKNOWN","NOT_RUN") for s in statuses.values()) else "READY"; print(json.dumps({"gates":rows,"decision":decision,"blocked_dependencies":blocked,"observed_findings":findings,"unknown_finding_gates":unknown},separators=(",",":")))'"'"
